tcm.note: Rou gui is one of TCM's great interior-warming herbs.

histamine.note: Mild liberator; cassia more than true cinnamon.
histamine.why: Reported as a liberator widely outside the SIGHI list, which does not mark it. Taseer marks it, and the reactive preparations are built on that reading.

nutrition.highlight: cassia and true cinnamon are not the same bark

effects.note: Meta-analyses across dozens of trials find a real fasting-glucose drop, though results are inconsistent study to study and the effect on longer-term markers like HbA1c is weaker. Worth flagging: this evidence is almost all cassia, the everyday supermarket bark, which carries far more coumarin than true Ceylon cinnamon — daily teaspoon-plus habits can approach the EU's coumarin safety limit. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
